translations.web: Are you better than No-Amon, who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her; whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
translations.bsb: Are you better than Thebes, stationed by the Nile with water around her, whose rampart was the sea, whose wall was the water?
translations.kjv: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
translations.asv: Art thou better than No-amon, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about her; whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
